b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the result to a
file or to standard output.

## Usage

```
python -m app.cli URL [options]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download (positional argument) |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

### Examples

Download to a file:

```
python -m app.cli https://example.com/file.bin -o file.bin
```

Download to standard output, quietly:

```
python -m app.cli https://example.com/file.bin -q
```
'
